about: Controls Help > Search Controls (Cmd-K) can find: the named components the tour can spotlight that are not catalogued commands. Fields: id (the component name; never renamed), title, where (plain language), words (extra match words), reveal (an ActionCatalog id run first to bring it on screen, or null), doc (optional path or URL of the page that explains it). Commands come from ActionCatalog and CommandRegistry, not from here. ControlSearchCheck and RegistryCheck hold every id to a name the code assigns. See docs/commands.md.
